patches_modified.previous_description: Adds an option to show the dislike count of videos with Return YouTube Dislike.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes the tracking query parameters from shared links.

patches_modified.name: Save to Watch later
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to display save to Watch later button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Seekbar
patches_modified.description: Adds options to show old seekbar thumbnails, disable precise seeking when swiping up on the seekbar, slide to seek instead of playing at 2x speed when pressing and holding, tapping the player seekbar to seek, hiding the video player seekbar, enabling seeking in live streams, and expanding the live stream DVR duration.

patches_modified.name: Settings menu filter
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide items on the standard YouTube settings screen by their visible name.

patches_modified.name: Shorts autoplay
patches_modified.description: Adds options to automatically play the next Short.

patches_modified.name: SponsorBlock
patches_modified.description: Adds options to enable and configure SponsorBlock, which can skip undesired video segments such as sponsored content.

patches_modified.name: Spoof app version
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to trick the app into thinking you are running an older version.

patches_modified.name: Spoof device dimensions
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to spoof the device dimensions which can unlock higher video qualities.

patches_modified.name: Spoof video streams
patches_modified.description: Adds options to spoof the client video streams to fix playback.

patches_modified.name: Swipe controls
patches_modified.description: Adds options to enable and configure volume and brightness swipe controls.

patches_modified.name: Theme
patches_modified.description: Adds options for theming, and settings to change the app foreground and background colors.

patches_modified.name: Video quality
patches_modified.description: Adds options to set default video qualities and always use the advanced video quality menu.

patches_modified.name: Voice over translation
patches_modified.description: Adds additional voice over languages using text-to-speech synchronized to the video playback.

patches_modified.name: Wide search bar
patches_modified.description: Adds a wide search bar to the top of the home and subscription feed.

patches_added.name: App icon
patches_added.description: Adds an option to select from the Reddit app icons available in the manifest.

patches_added.name: Copy text
patches_added.description: Adds an option to make post and comment text selectable and copyable. Disables collapsing comments. This patch works with Reddit 2026.24.0 and newer.

patches_added.name: Customize post layout
patches_added.description: Adds options to show the view count of posts, to move the vote and comment buttons of posts to the right side, and to swap the vote and comment buttons. Moving and swapping the buttons works with Reddit 2026.39.0 and newer.

patches_added.name: Download location
patches_added.description: Adds options to choose the folder and file name of downloaded images and videos, which can use the subreddit, author and account, and can be set per account.

patches_added.name: Feed media max height
patches_added.description: Adds an option to change the maximum height of images, videos and galleries in the feed.

patches_added.name: Full width feed media
patches_added.description: Adds an option to show images and videos edge to edge in the feed and post details, without side padding and rounded corners.

patches_added.name: Hide media viewer components
patches_added.description: Adds options to hide the "See the conversation" button and the title, buttons and video controls of the media viewer. Hiding the title, buttons and video controls requires Reddit 2026.38.0 or newer.

patches_added.name: Keep feed position
patches_added.description: Adds an option to keep the feed at the same position after closing a post, image or video, instead of moving the opened post to the top of the screen.

patches_added.name: Media viewer black background
patches_added.description: Adds an option to use a black background behind images and videos in the media viewer, instead of the theme background color.

patches_added.name: Media viewer fade
patches_added.description: Adds an option to lower or remove the dark fade behind the caption when viewing images and videos.

patches_added.name: Redgifs audio
patches_added.description: Adds an option to play the original Redgifs video, which has audio, instead of Reddit's silent copy.

patches_added.name: Remember collapsed comments
patches_added.description: Adds an option to keep comments you collapsed collapsed when reopening a post.

patches_added.name: Show flairs in home feed
patches_added.description: Adds an option to show post flair badges in the home feed. This patch works with Reddit 2026.24.0 and newer.

patches_added.name: Start as guest
patches_added.description: Skips the forced startup login screen using Reddit's native guest browsing mode.

patches_removed.name: Remove Enable NSFW button
patches_removed.description: Forcibly removes the Enable NSFW button from Reddit settings.

patches_removed.name: Show view count
patches_removed.description: Adds an option to show the view count of Posts.

patches_modified.name: Custom branding name for Reddit
patches_modified.description: Changes the Reddit app name to the name specified in patch options.

patches_modified.name: Custom font
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to replace Reddit Sans / Roboto with a custom TTF or OTF font file at runtime.

patches_modified.name: Disable modern home
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable the modern home UI. This patch works with Reddit 2026.24.0 and earlier.

patches_modified.name: Disable screenshot popup
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable the popup that appears when taking a screenshot.

patches_modified.name: Force system font

patches_modified.name: Hide Ask button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide Ask button in the search bar.

patches_modified.name: Hide Reddit search
patches_modified.description: Permanently hides the Reddit search in the contextual menu. This patch does not work with root mounting

patches_modified.name: Hide Trending shelves

patches_modified.name: Hide ads

patches_modified.name: Hide communities shelf

patches_modified.name: Hide navigation buttons

patches_modified.name: Hide sidebar components
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide the sidebar components.

patches_modified.name: Open links externally
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to always open links in your browser instead of with the in-app-browser.

patches_added.name: Inspect HTTPS traffic (adb reverse proxy)
patches_added.description: Routes RN network traffic through 127.0.0.1:8080 on the device (adb reverse tunnel to mitmproxy). Off by default; needs the tunnel and a trusted CA.

patches_added.name: Spoof stock signing cert hash
patches_added.description: Makes NativeUtils.setAppToken() return the stock app's certificate hash instead of the patched build's, so the server-side device/app integrity verdict ('App Error: NO IMSI') is not tripped by the re-signed APK.

patches_added.name: Double tap to skip
patches_added.description: A double tap on the left or right edge of a reel or video skips back or forward 10 seconds, or 5 on one under 30 seconds. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_added.name: Home header text
patches_added.description: Shows your own words or picture at the top of Home instead of the Facebook logo. Words take Facebook's own colors for light and dark mode. Type them in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance > Home header text, or pick a picture under Home header picture. Blank keeps Facebook's logo.

patches_added.name: Tap shows the controls
patches_added.description: A tap on a playing reel shows its controls and lets it keep playing, so you can skip or mute without stopping it. The button in the middle still pauses. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.previous_description: Unlocks the Pro/Premium features and lifts the free-version feature locks.

patches_modified.name: Disable telemetry
patches_modified.description: Disables telemetry and crash report uploads.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops Glean telemetry uploads (including the pings that ignore the in-app switch), the daily usage ping, Adjust marketing attribution, Sentry and Socorro crash report uploads and Nimbus experiment downloads. Crashes still show the local crash screen.

patches_modified.name: Enable about:config
patches_modified.description: Enables about:config.
patches_modified.previous_description: Opens about:config in release builds, where Firefox normally blocks it.

patches_modified.name: Hide promotional prompts
patches_modified.description: Hides default browser, rating and promo prompts.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops Firefox's own promotions: in-app messages and their notifications, microsurveys, the "Set as default browser" prompts (at start, in onboarding and in the follow-up onboarding days), the onboarding sign-in page and the rating prompt. Sign-in, Set as default browser and Rate on Google Play in settings keep working.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored content
patches_modified.description: Hides sponsored shortcuts, stories and suggestions.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the sponsored shortcuts on the home screen, sponsored stories and sponsored Firefox Suggest results in the address bar. Regular stories, shortcuts and suggestions stay.

patches_modified.name: Keep background tabs loaded
patches_modified.description: Experimental: keeps background tabs loaded so they reload less often. Uses more memory.
patches_modified.previous_description: Experimental: keeps the content processes of background tabs at background priority instead of letting them drop to idle, so Android is less likely to kill them and tabs reload less often. Raises memory use, and cannot stop Android from killing the whole app. Shows the last screenshot of a tab while it reloads.

patches_modified.name: Unlock secret settings
patches_modified.description: Unlocks the hidden debug settings.
patches_modified.previous_description: Reveals the hidden debug menu without tapping the Firefox logo five times: Secret Settings, Install add-on from file, the custom add-on collection, Nimbus experiments, the Sync debug menu and Gecko logs.

patches_modified.name: Disable rating prompts
patches_modified.description: Disables the rating prompt.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops the Google Play rating request that opens after a few app starts, and the Play Store page it opens when that request fails.

patches_modified.name: Disable telemetry
patches_modified.description: Disables the usage ping and experiments.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops the daily usage ping, even when its setting is turned on, and Nimbus experiment downloads. The other Glean telemetry is already off in Firefox Focus. Crash reports are still sent only when you choose to send them.

patches_modified.name: Enable about:config
patches_modified.description: Enables about:config.
patches_modified.previous_description: Enables about:config, the page for viewing and changing the browser engine's preferences. Type about:config in the address bar to open it.

patches_modified.name: Hide promotional prompts
patches_modified.description: Hides the search widget promo and tip bubbles.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the search widget promotion that opens after erasing your history and the tip bubbles ("Start browsing", tracking protection, erase tabs, privacy settings).

patches_modified.name: Enable Premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks premium features.
patches_modified.previous_description: Unlocks Hyperion Premium features without a purchase or the Launcher Key app.

patches_modified.name: Disable ads
patches_modified.description: Removes banner ads and video ads.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the banner ads and empty ad slots in articles, listings, results and the live programme list, and the pre-roll ads before live channels and videos.

patches_modified.name: Disable live stream ads
patches_modified.description: Removes ads from live channels. Turn off if a channel stops playing.
patches_modified.previous_description: Plays live channels from the plain stream instead of the Google DAI stream with inserted ads. Turn this off if a live channel stops playing.

patches_modified.name: Disable telemetry
patches_modified.description: Disables analytics and crash reporting.
patches_modified.previous_description: Disables Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance Monitoring and Piano (Cxense) page events. Push notifications keep working.

patches_modified.name: Disable update prompts
patches_modified.description: Disables the in-app update prompt.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops the Play Store in-app update prompt. An old version may still stop working if Digi Sport's servers drop support for it.

patches_modified.name: Hide betting odds
patches_modified.description: Hides betting odds in match lists.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the bookmaker odds block in soccer match rows.

patches_modified.name: Hide promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides cross-promotion articles and the live bar on Home.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the cross-promotion articles from other RCS&RDS apps below articles and the "Exclusive online · live" bar on Home.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored articles
patches_modified.description: Hides sponsored articles.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides sponsored articles in section listings and in the article widgets below an article.

patches_modified.name: Skip ad consent form
patches_modified.description: Skips the ad consent form.
patches_modified.previous_description: Skips Google's ad consent form at startup and in the GDPR screens, and hides the then empty ad consent section in Settings. Use it together with Disable ads.

patches_modified.name: Disable ads
patches_modified.description: Removes all ads.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the banner and interstitial ads.

patches_modified.name: Disable ads
patches_modified.description: Removes all ads.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the display and native ads from section fronts, articles and market pages, without leaving empty ad slots, and the pre-roll ads before videos.

patches_added.name: Redirect API to v2 Boot
patches_added.description: Loads effects, feeds and templates where default endpoints are blocked by using official alternate endpoints.

patches_modified.name: Block Telemetry & Trackers
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes Google AppMeasurement, AppsFlyer, ByteDance AppLog, APM/Slardar, Gecko, Pitaya, BDTuring, and UserGrowth event dispatchers.
patches_modified.previous_description: Neutralizes Google AppMeasurement, AppsFlyer, and ByteDance AppLog event dispatchers.

patches_modified.name: Remove Watermark
patches_modified.description: Forces CapCut watermark-removal gates and default ending gate to allow export without watermark or outro.
patches_modified.previous_description: Forces CapCut watermark-removal gates to allow export without watermark (WatermarkBusinessFunction).

patches_modified.name: Fix Google Maps
patches_modified.description: Restores Google Maps rendering by spoofing the original package signature to Google Play Services.

patches_added.name: Hide rows in Instagram's settings
patches_added.description: Lets you take the rows you don't use off Instagram's own Settings and activity screen. Open that screen once, then untick rows in HushGram settings > Layout > Rows in Instagram's settings. Every row shows to start.

patches_added.name: Story text fonts
patches_added.description: Adds fonts you pick from your phone (.ttf or .otf files) to the story text editor, after Instagram's own fonts, and can draw the emoji in story text from an emoji font file you pick. Starts off. Set both up in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Accent color
patches_modified.description: Swaps Instagram's blue on Follow buttons, links and other highlights for purple, pink, red, orange, green, teal or your wallpaper's colors (Material You, on Android 12 and newer). Restart Instagram to see a change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.
patches_modified.previous_description: Swaps Instagram's blue on Follow buttons, links and other highlights for purple, pink, red, orange, green or teal. Restart Instagram to see a change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested posts
patches_modified.description: Removes posts from accounts you don't follow, suggested accounts, surveys and shopping rows from Home. It also takes shop tiles out of Explore and the shopping bag off posts with tagged products. Posts from accounts you follow stay. Extra switches can also hide the 'Are you interested in this post?' question on Home and Reels, the caught up card, all videos, photos, carousels, posts you've liked or posts from accounts you pick. A post's menu has Hide posts from this account to add one to that list, and those posts leave Home on the next refresh. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Feed.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes posts from accounts you don't follow, suggested accounts, surveys and shopping rows from Home. It also takes shop tiles out of Explore and the shopping bag off posts with tagged products. Posts from accounts you follow stay. Extra switches can also hide the 'Are you interested in this post?' question, the caught up card, all videos, photos, carousels, posts you've liked or posts from accounts you pick. A post's menu has Hide posts from this account to add one to that list, and those posts leave Home on the next refresh. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_added.name: Purple theme
patches_added.description: Recolors the app's accent (selected tabs, buttons, highlights, progress) from the stock orange to a purple gradient. Does not change the layout of any screen.

apps.app_name: JPTT - 行動裝置也能輕鬆瀏覽PTT!

patches_added.name: Advanced downloads
patches_added.description: Adds more ways to save: pick the video quality, save full-size photos, the sound on its own or a photo post as one video, hold a profile picture or story to save it, save a story or a video's cover from the share sheet, and pick videos on a profile grid to save in one run. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Downloads.

patches_added.name: Allow photo comments
patches_added.description: Lets PineDrama's comment box ask TikTok's server about photo comments, like TikTok does. TikTok's server still decides whether your account can post one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_added.name: Automatic video advance
patches_added.description: Moves on to the next video by itself when one ends, so you can watch hands-free. It can also turn on TikTok's auto scroll in search results. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Hide inbox items
patches_added.description: Lets you hide Inbox rows you don't use, like message requests, TikTok Shop and the stories row, plus call buttons and suggested replies in chats. Each has its own switch. Also offers search in loaded Activity notifications. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_added.name: Hide profile shortcuts
patches_added.description: Hides the shortcuts you pick from the row under a profile's bio, like TikTok Studio or Your orders, and can hide the Thoughts bubble, and Balance and the TikTok Minis icons in your profile's menu. It can also turn Thoughts on for accounts TikTok left out. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches_added.name: Load all saved stickers
patches_added.description: Loads every sticker you saved when you open the sticker panel. PineDrama otherwise shows only the first 100 and never loads the rest. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_added.name: Open the comments at full height
patches_added.description: Opens the comment sheet at the full height of the screen instead of part way up. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_added.name: Show the progress bar
patches_added.description: Shows the progress bar on videos where TikTok hides it, so you can see how long a video is and skip around. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback, where you can also show the time beside the bar or give it a bigger handle. Seek bars for video stories and sound previews are there too.

patches_removed.name: Always upload in HD
patches_removed.description: Posts every video you upload in HD, as if you'd turned on TikTok's own HD upload setting each time. Videos TikTok doesn't count as high quality post as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_removed.name: Foldable split comment view
patches_removed.description: On a folding phone or tablet, shows comments beside the video instead of over it when the screen is wide enough. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_removed.name: Story controls
patches_removed.description: Lets a story replay when it ends instead of moving on, and keeps a photo story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Allow Duet and Stitch
patches_modified.description: Shows the Duet and Stitch buttons on videos whose creator turned them off, so you can still make one, and Add to Story in the share sheet and on stories when the creator turned off content reuse. TikTok may still refuse some videos or the upload. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows the Duet and Stitch buttons on videos whose creator turned them off, so you can still make one. TikTok may still refuse some videos or the upload. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.

patches_modified.name: Allow screenshots and Circle to Search
patches_modified.description: Lets screenshots, screen recordings and Circle to Search work on TikTok screens that would otherwise come out black. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Always show publish date
patches_modified.description: Shows the date a video was posted next to the creator's name, so you can tell how old it is. It can also show the exact time, dates and lengths on profile grids, or sort the videos a grid has loaded. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Block P2P video relay
patches_modified.description: Removes the files TikTok uses to pass videos on to other viewers through your phone's internet connection. The app gets about 3.5 MB smaller. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it brings them back.

patches_modified.name: Block contact list access
patches_modified.description: Gives TikTok an empty contact list when it tries to read your phone's contacts, so it can't use them to suggest friends. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Block installed app scanning
patches_modified.description: Gives TikTok an empty list when it asks which apps are on your phone, so it learns less about you. Opening another app from TikTok still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Block suggested video notifications
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok's "Videos you might like" notifications about popular videos it picked for you. Messages, comments, likes and posts from people you follow still come through. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Camera and microphone indicator
patches_modified.description: Shows a small mark in the top corner while TikTok is using the camera or microphone, so you always know when it is. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Change app name
patches_modified.description: Shows a name you choose under the app icon, so the patched TikTok is easy to tell apart from another copy. Type the name in this patch's options. Inside the app it still says TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Comment publish diagnostics
patches_modified.description: Adds a note to Hushfeed's diagnostic report about how far a comment got when it fails to post, which helps track down comments that vanish without an error. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Comment send fix
patches_modified.description: Fixes comments that TikTok sometimes drops without any message, so the comment you send actually posts. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Comment sort controls
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's full comment sort menu on every video, with hot, newest, media and creator options, even when your account only got a cut-down version. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Copy comments without username
patches_modified.description: When you copy a comment, you get just its text, without the username in front. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Custom offline videos limit
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick how many videos TikTok saves for watching offline, from 1 to 10,000, and keep them until you delete them. Handy when you're often without internet. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Device privacy guard
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok reading what you copied and gives it a blank advertising ID. Can also hide a VPN connection and root status with details about root tools, and give TikTok a new device identity. Each switch starts off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy. Changing Hide root needs a restart.

patches_modified.name: Diagnostic tools
patches_modified.description: Adds logs and reports you can save or share when something goes wrong, so a problem is easier to report and fix. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.

patches_modified.name: Disable login requirement
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok from forcing you to sign in before you can keep browsing. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Disable screen capture detection
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok from noticing and reacting when you take a screenshot or record the screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Disable the long press quick share
patches_modified.description: Stops a long press on Share from opening TikTok's quick share, so you don't send a video by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Disable the long press repost
patches_modified.description: Stops a long press on Like from opening TikTok's repost option, so you don't repost by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Downloads
patches_modified.description: Saves videos and photos without TikTok's watermark, even when the creator turned downloads off. You can also choose the folders and file names. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Drop the animated image cache
patches_modified.description: Lets you make TikTok decode animated stickers and GIFs one frame at a time as they play, instead of a few frames ahead, so they use a little less memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Enable voice comments
patches_modified.description: Lets you turn on TikTok's voice comments, so you can record and post a spoken comment, for accounts that don't have them yet. It hasn't been tried on a real account, so it may not work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Expand activity list
patches_modified.description: Shows the whole Activity and New followers lists in the Inbox, so you don't have to tap View all. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Feature Gate Lab
patches_modified.description: Adds an advanced page that lists the hidden settings TikTok uses to test features and lets you change them. It's for people who like to experiment. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.

patches_modified.name: Feature Gate Recorder
patches_modified.description: Records which hidden TikTok settings the app reads while you use it, and which ones changed. It's a research tool and changes nothing in TikTok. Start a recording in Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.

patches_modified.name: Fit the video to the screen
patches_modified.description: Shows the whole video instead of cutting off its sides on folding phones, squarer screens and split screen, and fits photo slideshows whole on squarer screens. A second switch does the opposite and fills the screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Fix Google login
patches_modified.description: Makes Sign in with Google work in the patched app, where it would otherwise fail. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Ghost mode
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok telling people you viewed their story or profile, or that you're typing. What TikTok already recorded stays. A separate switch hides your online status. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide Play Store update offer
patches_modified.description: Stops the Play Store offering to swap the patched TikTok for the store version. The catch: a build with a lower version number won't install over it, and uninstalling to go back can erase TikTok's data on your phone.

patches_modified.name: Hide comment popup ads
patches_modified.description: Stops the brand animation that pops up over the comments when someone types a word or emoji an advertiser paid for. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide comment typing suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the emoji and sticker suggestions that pop up above the comment box while you type. The emoji and sticker buttons still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed follow button
patches_modified.description: Removes the + follow button under creators' pictures on the feed, so you don't follow someone by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed save button
patches_modified.description: Removes the save button from the right side of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed search button
patches_modified.description: Removes the search button from the top right of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide floating promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides the floating promotion badges, coins and timers on the feed, and can hide the rewards button on your profile. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, and App for the rewards button.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox stories
patches_modified.description: Hides the row of stories at the top of the Inbox. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide search suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the searches TikTok suggests before you type, and can hide the search rewards banner. Your own search history stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts
patches_modified.description: Hides TikTok's People you may like suggestions in the Inbox, on profiles, on the Friends tab and in the feed. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide the launcher shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Empties the menu that pops up when you press and hold TikTok's icon on your home screen. Tapping the icon still opens the app. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock
patches_modified.description: Turns on TikTok's own gesture where you hold a video, slide down and let go to keep it playing fast without holding. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: In-app browser privacy guard
patches_modified.description: Stops websites you open in TikTok's built-in browser from reaching into the TikTok app. TikTok's own pages, like Watch history and checkout, keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Keep a streak going
patches_modified.description: Sends a daily message you choose to people you pick, at a time you set, so your message streaks keep going on days you don't open TikTok. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Keep playing in the background
patches_modified.description: Keeps the video playing when you leave TikTok or turn the screen off, with a notification to pause it. It can also start the video over when it ends. Handy for music and talks. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Keep pulled sounds
patches_modified.description: Plays the sound on videos TikTok muted for copyright or because of where you live. TikTok may still say the sound isn't available. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Keep the Favorites tab
patches_modified.description: Keeps the Favorites tab and your saved videos on your profile when TikTok tries out a version of the app that hides them, and makes the collections popup you get by holding the Favorites button dark when TikTok is. Both are on by default. Turn them off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Keep the app language
patches_modified.description: Lets you keep the language you picked in TikTok's own settings. When TikTok starts and decides the phone's language changed, it drops that pick and follows the phone, which can leave it in the wrong language after a reboot. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Keep the screen's refresh rate
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok slowing your screen down to the video's frame rate, so scrolling stays smooth on 90 or 120 Hz phones. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Limit background traffic
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop TikTok loading upcoming videos ahead of time, which uses less data in the background, but videos may take a moment longer to start. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Location access governor
patches_modified.description: Gives TikTok no location when it asks, so it can't see where you are from your phone's location services. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Look like the store app
patches_modified.description: Makes the patched app answer TikTok's checks as if it came from the Play Store, which can help when follows or likes undo themselves. TikTok has other checks, so it may not be enough. On once picked. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Network proxy
patches_modified.description: Sends TikTok's feed, search and comments through a proxy server you set up. Videos and LIVEs still load directly, and so do Hushfeed's own saves and short-link lookups. Other apps aren't affected. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Network request report
patches_modified.description: Counts the requests TikTok sends to its servers and adds the totals to the diagnostic report. It changes nothing in TikTok, but it has no switch and most people don't need it.

patches_modified.name: Notification controls
patches_modified.description: Lets you turn off new follower notifications and streak reminders, which TikTok has no switch for, or turn off TikTok's notifications altogether. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Open external links directly
patches_modified.description: Opens website links from profiles and stories in your phone's own browser instead of TikTok's built-in one. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Play SDR instead of HDR
patches_modified.description: Plays the normal version of HDR videos, so your screen doesn't suddenly jump to full brightness. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Playback quality
patches_modified.description: Lets you choose the video quality, like highest, lowest or 720p, and set a lower quality for mobile data to use less data. Starts off. Pick a quality in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Playback speed
patches_modified.description: Remembers the speed you picked for the next video, and lets you set a default speed, add speeds up to 3x to the menu and choose the speed for press and hold. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Prefer H.264 playback
patches_modified.description: Plays videos in an older format your phone decodes more easily, which can help older phones play smoothly and run cooler. Videos without it play as before. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Profile background
patches_modified.description: Opens TikTok's own profile background editor in Edit profile on accounts TikTok hasn't offered it to yet, and shows the backgrounds other profiles have set. TikTok's servers may still refuse to save one for such an account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Region spoof
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok's region and time zone match the country you set for SIM spoof. It changes every region check, sign-in included, and its store region switch is experimental, so it isn't picked for you. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region.

patches_modified.name: Remember clear display
patches_modified.description: Keeps clear display, TikTok's mode that hides the buttons over a video, on as you swipe to the next video (`Keep Clear display across videos` turns that part off). It can also turn on by itself after a delay you pick, which starts off in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen. When clear display ends, the Following stories bubble TikTok hid comes back too.

patches_modified.name: Remove unused language packs
patches_modified.description: Removes the app languages you don't list in this patch's options, saving up to about 26 MB of storage. English is always kept. With no list it keeps them all. Only patching again brings removed ones back.

patches_modified.name: Resource and battery governor
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok reading your phone's motion sensors, which it can use to identify your phone, and stops a background speed test that can use a lot of memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Resume videos after scrolling
patches_modified.description: When you scroll back to a video, it picks up where you left off instead of starting over. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: SIM spoof
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok see the SIM country and carrier you choose. It may not change your region, since TikTok also goes by your internet connection and account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes the tracking codes from TikTok links you share, so the link carries less about you. It can also swap tiktok.com for another site. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Settings
patches_modified.description: Adds the Hushfeed settings page to TikTok, at the top of Settings and privacy. Pressing and holding For You at the top of the feed opens it too. That's where you turn Hushfeed's features on and off. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Show LIVE search
patches_modified.description: Adds TikTok's search button inside the LIVE section where TikTok supports it, so you can look for LIVEs. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Show commenter handle and region
patches_modified.description: Shows a commenter's @username in place of their display name and the country their account is set to after the comment's time. It can also give each commenter's name a color of its own. Each starts off. Turn them on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Show the progress bar thumbnail
patches_modified.description: Shows a small preview picture while you drag the progress bar, so you can find the part you want. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Skip content warnings
patches_modified.description: Plays videos without the warning screen you'd have to tap through first, and can hide the Check sources and Check your sources banners. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Skip first-launch setup
patches_modified.description: Skips TikTok's setup screens on a fresh install, like the interest picker and the swipe tutorial. Sign-in and age screens still show. Its switch is on once picked, since setup runs before you can reach settings. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Skip passkey sign-in
patches_modified.description: Lets you sign in another way, like your password or a code by email or text, when TikTok wants a passkey. Password managers won't hand a passkey to a patched app, so that step can't finish here. With the switch on, TikTok treats your phone as one without passkeys. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Skip the splash ad
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop the full-screen ad TikTok can show while it starts up. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Skip update checks
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop two background tasks TikTok uses to check for updates, one of them when your phone starts. Some in-app update prompts may stop. Play Store updates still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Stay on the video in full screen
patches_modified.description: When a video ends in TikTok's full screen view, it stays on that video instead of moving to the next one. Swiping still moves on. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Stop on-device AI profiling
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop TikTok's built-in AI engine from starting, so it doesn't get a copy of everything TikTok logs about your use. TikTok works as if the engine weren't there. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop recording watch history
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok adding the videos you watch to your Watch history. The catch: your views stop counting, and For You learns less about what you like. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop saving search history
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok saving your new searches on your phone. Older searches stay until you delete them, and TikTok's servers may keep their own record. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop search autoplay
patches_modified.description: Stops videos in search results from playing by themselves. Each one shows its cover until you open it, so searching stays quiet. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Translate comments
patches_modified.description: Translates comments as they load, using TikTok's own translator, so you don't have to tap Translate on each one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments, where more rows list languages TikTok's automatic translation should leave alone, keep videos in the language they were made in, pick the language translations come out in, and add TikTok's translate button beside the comment count.

patches_modified.name: Trust user certificates
patches_modified.description: Lets TikTok trust security certificates you install yourself, so a tool like mitmproxy can show what the app sends. The risk: anyone who gets a certificate onto your phone can read TikTok's traffic too. Use it only on a test phone.

patches_modified.name: Turn off haptics
patches_modified.description: Stops the little vibrations TikTok makes when you tap or hold things. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Turn off screen transitions
patches_modified.description: Opens and closes TikTok's screens without the sliding animation, so moving around feels quicker. Swipes still follow your finger. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Use non-personalized search
patches_modified.description: Shows search results that aren't tailored to your account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Use system font
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's text in your phone's own font or in a .ttf or .otf font file you import, instead of TikTok's, and can use your phone's emoji too. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches_added.name: Load all saved stickers
patches_added.description: Loads every sticker you saved when you open the sticker panel. PineDrama otherwise shows only the first 100 and never loads the rest. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_added.name: Report a newer phone to effects
patches_added.description: Tells TikTok's effects server you have a newer phone, so effects it turns down on older phones get another chance. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Allow Duet and Stitch
patches_modified.description: Shows the Duet and Stitch buttons on videos whose creator turned them off, so you can still make one, and Add to Story in the share sheet and on stories when the creator turned off content reuse. TikTok may still refuse some videos or the upload. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows the Duet and Stitch buttons on videos whose creator turned them off, so you can still make one. TikTok may still refuse some videos or the upload. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.

patches_modified.name: Hide profile shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Hides the shortcuts you pick from the row under a profile's bio, like TikTok Studio or Your orders, and can hide the Thoughts bubble, and Balance and the TikTok Minis icons in your profile's menu. It can also turn Thoughts on for accounts TikTok left out. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the shortcuts you pick from the row under a profile's bio, like TikTok Studio or Your orders, and can hide the Thoughts bubble, and Balance and the TikTok Minis icons in your profile's menu. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Remove avatar rings
patches_modified.description: Takes the story and LIVE rings off profile pictures, so tapping a picture opens the profile instead of a story or LIVE. It can also open a LIVE creator's Story from their profile picture or their chat in the Inbox. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes the story and LIVE rings off profile pictures, so tapping a picture opens the profile instead of a story or LIVE. It can also open a LIVE creator's Story from their profile picture. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_added.name: Advanced downloads
patches_added.description: Adds more ways to save: pick the video quality, save full-size photos, the sound on its own or a photo post as one video, hold a profile picture or story to save it, save a story or a video's cover from the share sheet, and pick videos on a profile grid to save in one run. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Downloads.

patches_added.name: Allow photo comments
patches_added.description: Lets PineDrama's comment box ask TikTok's server about photo comments, like TikTok does. TikTok's server still decides whether your account can post one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_added.name: Automatic video advance
patches_added.description: Moves on to the next video by itself when one ends, so you can watch hands-free. It can also turn on TikTok's auto scroll in search results. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Hide inbox items
patches_added.description: Lets you hide Inbox rows you don't use, like message requests, TikTok Shop and the stories row, plus call buttons and suggested replies in chats. Each has its own switch. Also offers search in loaded Activity notifications. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_added.name: Hide profile shortcuts
patches_added.description: Hides the shortcuts you pick from the row under a profile's bio, like TikTok Studio or Your orders, and can hide the Thoughts bubble, and Balance and the TikTok Minis icons in your profile's menu. It can also turn Thoughts on for accounts TikTok left out. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches_added.name: Load all saved stickers
patches_added.description: Loads every sticker you saved when you open the sticker panel. PineDrama otherwise shows only the first 100 and never loads the rest. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_added.name: Open the comments at full height
patches_added.description: Opens the comment sheet at the full height of the screen instead of part way up. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_added.name: Show the progress bar
patches_added.description: Shows the progress bar on videos where TikTok hides it, so you can see how long a video is and skip around. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback, where you can also show the time beside the bar or give it a bigger handle. Seek bars for video stories and sound previews are there too.

patches_removed.name: Always upload in HD
patches_removed.description: Posts every video you upload in HD, as if you'd turned on TikTok's own HD upload setting each time. Videos TikTok doesn't count as high quality post as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_removed.name: Foldable split comment view
patches_removed.description: On a folding phone or tablet, shows comments beside the video instead of over it when the screen is wide enough. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_removed.name: Story controls
patches_removed.description: Lets a story replay when it ends instead of moving on, and keeps a photo story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Allow Duet and Stitch
patches_modified.description: Shows the Duet and Stitch buttons on videos whose creator turned them off, so you can still make one, and Add to Story in the share sheet and on stories when the creator turned off content reuse. TikTok may still refuse some videos or the upload. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows the Duet and Stitch buttons on videos whose creator turned them off, so you can still make one. TikTok may still refuse some videos or the upload. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.

patches_modified.name: Allow screenshots and Circle to Search
patches_modified.description: Lets screenshots, screen recordings and Circle to Search work on TikTok screens that would otherwise come out black. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Always show publish date
patches_modified.description: Shows the date a video was posted next to the creator's name, so you can tell how old it is. It can also show the exact time, dates and lengths on profile grids, or sort the videos a grid has loaded. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Block P2P video relay
patches_modified.description: Removes the files TikTok uses to pass videos on to other viewers through your phone's internet connection. The app gets about 3.5 MB smaller. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it brings them back.

patches_modified.name: Block contact list access
patches_modified.description: Gives TikTok an empty contact list when it tries to read your phone's contacts, so it can't use them to suggest friends. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Block installed app scanning
patches_modified.description: Gives TikTok an empty list when it asks which apps are on your phone, so it learns less about you. Opening another app from TikTok still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Block suggested video notifications
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok's "Videos you might like" notifications about popular videos it picked for you. Messages, comments, likes and posts from people you follow still come through. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Camera and microphone indicator
patches_modified.description: Shows a small mark in the top corner while TikTok is using the camera or microphone, so you always know when it is. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Change app name
patches_modified.description: Shows a name you choose under the app icon, so the patched TikTok is easy to tell apart from another copy. Type the name in this patch's options. Inside the app it still says TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Comment publish diagnostics
patches_modified.description: Adds a note to Hushfeed's diagnostic report about how far a comment got when it fails to post, which helps track down comments that vanish without an error. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Comment send fix
patches_modified.description: Fixes comments that TikTok sometimes drops without any message, so the comment you send actually posts. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Comment sort controls
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's full comment sort menu on every video, with hot, newest, media and creator options, even when your account only got a cut-down version. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Copy comments without username
patches_modified.description: When you copy a comment, you get just its text, without the username in front. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Custom offline videos limit
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick how many videos TikTok saves for watching offline, from 1 to 10,000, and keep them until you delete them. Handy when you're often without internet. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Device privacy guard
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok reading what you copied and gives it a blank advertising ID. Can also hide a VPN connection and root status with details about root tools, and give TikTok a new device identity. Each switch starts off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy. Changing Hide root needs a restart.

patches_modified.name: Diagnostic tools
patches_modified.description: Adds logs and reports you can save or share when something goes wrong, so a problem is easier to report and fix. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.

patches_modified.name: Disable login requirement
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok from forcing you to sign in before you can keep browsing. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Disable screen capture detection
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok from noticing and reacting when you take a screenshot or record the screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Disable the long press quick share
patches_modified.description: Stops a long press on Share from opening TikTok's quick share, so you don't send a video by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Disable the long press repost
patches_modified.description: Stops a long press on Like from opening TikTok's repost option, so you don't repost by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Downloads
patches_modified.description: Saves videos and photos without TikTok's watermark, even when the creator turned downloads off. You can also choose the folders and file names. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Drop the animated image cache
patches_modified.description: Lets you make TikTok decode animated stickers and GIFs one frame at a time as they play, instead of a few frames ahead, so they use a little less memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Enable voice comments
patches_modified.description: Lets you turn on TikTok's voice comments, so you can record and post a spoken comment, for accounts that don't have them yet. It hasn't been tried on a real account, so it may not work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Expand activity list
patches_modified.description: Shows the whole Activity and New followers lists in the Inbox, so you don't have to tap View all. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Feature Gate Lab
patches_modified.description: Adds an advanced page that lists the hidden settings TikTok uses to test features and lets you change them. It's for people who like to experiment. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.

patches_modified.name: Feature Gate Recorder
patches_modified.description: Records which hidden TikTok settings the app reads while you use it, and which ones changed. It's a research tool and changes nothing in TikTok. Start a recording in Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.

patches_modified.name: Fit the video to the screen
patches_modified.description: Shows the whole video instead of cutting off its sides on folding phones, squarer screens and split screen, and fits photo slideshows whole on squarer screens. A second switch does the opposite and fills the screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Fix Google login
patches_modified.description: Makes Sign in with Google work in the patched app, where it would otherwise fail. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Ghost mode
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok telling people you viewed their story or profile, or that you're typing. What TikTok already recorded stays. A separate switch hides your online status. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide Play Store update offer
patches_modified.description: Stops the Play Store offering to swap the patched TikTok for the store version. The catch: a build with a lower version number won't install over it, and uninstalling to go back can erase TikTok's data on your phone.

patches_modified.name: Hide comment popup ads
patches_modified.description: Stops the brand animation that pops up over the comments when someone types a word or emoji an advertiser paid for. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide comment typing suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the emoji and sticker suggestions that pop up above the comment box while you type. The emoji and sticker buttons still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed follow button
patches_modified.description: Removes the + follow button under creators' pictures on the feed, so you don't follow someone by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed save button
patches_modified.description: Removes the save button from the right side of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed search button
patches_modified.description: Removes the search button from the top right of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide floating promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides the floating promotion badges, coins and timers on the feed, and can hide the rewards button on your profile. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, and App for the rewards button.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox stories
patches_modified.description: Hides the row of stories at the top of the Inbox. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide search suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the searches TikTok suggests before you type, and can hide the search rewards banner. Your own search history stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts
patches_modified.description: Hides TikTok's People you may like suggestions in the Inbox, on profiles, on the Friends tab and in the feed. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide the launcher shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Empties the menu that pops up when you press and hold TikTok's icon on your home screen. Tapping the icon still opens the app. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock
patches_modified.description: Turns on TikTok's own gesture where you hold a video, slide down and let go to keep it playing fast without holding. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: In-app browser privacy guard
patches_modified.description: Stops websites you open in TikTok's built-in browser from reaching into the TikTok app. TikTok's own pages, like Watch history and checkout, keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Keep a streak going
patches_modified.description: Sends a daily message you choose to people you pick, at a time you set, so your message streaks keep going on days you don't open TikTok. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Keep playing in the background
patches_modified.description: Keeps the video playing when you leave TikTok or turn the screen off, with a notification to pause it. It can also start the video over when it ends. Handy for music and talks. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Keep pulled sounds
patches_modified.description: Plays the sound on videos TikTok muted for copyright or because of where you live. TikTok may still say the sound isn't available. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Keep the Favorites tab
patches_modified.description: Keeps the Favorites tab and your saved videos on your profile when TikTok tries out a version of the app that hides them, and makes the collections popup you get by holding the Favorites button dark when TikTok is. Both are on by default. Turn them off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Keep the app language
patches_modified.description: Lets you keep the language you picked in TikTok's own settings. When TikTok starts and decides the phone's language changed, it drops that pick and follows the phone, which can leave it in the wrong language after a reboot. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Keep the screen's refresh rate
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok slowing your screen down to the video's frame rate, so scrolling stays smooth on 90 or 120 Hz phones. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Limit background traffic
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop TikTok loading upcoming videos ahead of time, which uses less data in the background, but videos may take a moment longer to start. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Location access governor
patches_modified.description: Gives TikTok no location when it asks, so it can't see where you are from your phone's location services. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Look like the store app
patches_modified.description: Makes the patched app answer TikTok's checks as if it came from the Play Store, which can help when follows or likes undo themselves. TikTok has other checks, so it may not be enough. On once picked. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Network proxy
patches_modified.description: Sends TikTok's feed, search and comments through a proxy server you set up. Videos and LIVEs still load directly, and so do Hushfeed's own saves and short-link lookups. Other apps aren't affected. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Network request report
patches_modified.description: Counts the requests TikTok sends to its servers and adds the totals to the diagnostic report. It changes nothing in TikTok, but it has no switch and most people don't need it.

patches_modified.name: Notification controls
patches_modified.description: Lets you turn off new follower notifications and streak reminders, which TikTok has no switch for, or turn off TikTok's notifications altogether. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Open external links directly
patches_modified.description: Opens website links from profiles and stories in your phone's own browser instead of TikTok's built-in one. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Play SDR instead of HDR
patches_modified.description: Plays the normal version of HDR videos, so your screen doesn't suddenly jump to full brightness. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Playback quality
patches_modified.description: Lets you choose the video quality, like highest, lowest or 720p, and set a lower quality for mobile data to use less data. Starts off. Pick a quality in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Playback speed
patches_modified.description: Remembers the speed you picked for the next video, and lets you set a default speed, add speeds up to 3x to the menu and choose the speed for press and hold. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Prefer H.264 playback
patches_modified.description: Plays videos in an older format your phone decodes more easily, which can help older phones play smoothly and run cooler. Videos without it play as before. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Profile background
patches_modified.description: Opens TikTok's own profile background editor in Edit profile on accounts TikTok hasn't offered it to yet, and shows the backgrounds other profiles have set. TikTok's servers may still refuse to save one for such an account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Region spoof
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok's region and time zone match the country you set for SIM spoof. It changes every region check, sign-in included, and its store region switch is experimental, so it isn't picked for you. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region.

patches_modified.name: Remember clear display
patches_modified.description: Keeps clear display, TikTok's mode that hides the buttons over a video, on as you swipe to the next video (`Keep Clear display across videos` turns that part off). It can also turn on by itself after a delay you pick, which starts off in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen. When clear display ends, the Following stories bubble TikTok hid comes back too.

patches_modified.name: Remove unused language packs
patches_modified.description: Removes the app languages you don't list in this patch's options, saving up to about 26 MB of storage. English is always kept. With no list it keeps them all. Only patching again brings removed ones back.

patches_modified.name: Resource and battery governor
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok reading your phone's motion sensors, which it can use to identify your phone, and stops a background speed test that can use a lot of memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Resume videos after scrolling
patches_modified.description: When you scroll back to a video, it picks up where you left off instead of starting over. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: SIM spoof
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok see the SIM country and carrier you choose. It may not change your region, since TikTok also goes by your internet connection and account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes the tracking codes from TikTok links you share, so the link carries less about you. It can also swap tiktok.com for another site. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Settings
patches_modified.description: Adds the Hushfeed settings page to TikTok, at the top of Settings and privacy. Pressing and holding For You at the top of the feed opens it too. That's where you turn Hushfeed's features on and off. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Show LIVE search
patches_modified.description: Adds TikTok's search button inside the LIVE section where TikTok supports it, so you can look for LIVEs. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Show commenter handle and region
patches_modified.description: Shows a commenter's @username in place of their display name and the country their account is set to after the comment's time. It can also give each commenter's name a color of its own. Each starts off. Turn them on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Show the progress bar thumbnail
patches_modified.description: Shows a small preview picture while you drag the progress bar, so you can find the part you want. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Skip content warnings
patches_modified.description: Plays videos without the warning screen you'd have to tap through first, and can hide the Check sources and Check your sources banners. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Skip first-launch setup
patches_modified.description: Skips TikTok's setup screens on a fresh install, like the interest picker and the swipe tutorial. Sign-in and age screens still show. Its switch is on once picked, since setup runs before you can reach settings. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Skip passkey sign-in
patches_modified.description: Lets you sign in another way, like your password or a code by email or text, when TikTok wants a passkey. Password managers won't hand a passkey to a patched app, so that step can't finish here. With the switch on, TikTok treats your phone as one without passkeys. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Skip the splash ad
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop the full-screen ad TikTok can show while it starts up. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Skip update checks
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop two background tasks TikTok uses to check for updates, one of them when your phone starts. Some in-app update prompts may stop. Play Store updates still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Stay on the video in full screen
patches_modified.description: When a video ends in TikTok's full screen view, it stays on that video instead of moving to the next one. Swiping still moves on. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Stop on-device AI profiling
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop TikTok's built-in AI engine from starting, so it doesn't get a copy of everything TikTok logs about your use. TikTok works as if the engine weren't there. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop recording watch history
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok adding the videos you watch to your Watch history. The catch: your views stop counting, and For You learns less about what you like. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop saving search history
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok saving your new searches on your phone. Older searches stay until you delete them, and TikTok's servers may keep their own record. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop search autoplay
patches_modified.description: Stops videos in search results from playing by themselves. Each one shows its cover until you open it, so searching stays quiet. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Translate comments
patches_modified.description: Translates comments as they load, using TikTok's own translator, so you don't have to tap Translate on each one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments, where more rows list languages TikTok's automatic translation should leave alone, keep videos in the language they were made in, pick the language translations come out in, and add TikTok's translate button beside the comment count.

patches_modified.name: Trust user certificates
patches_modified.description: Lets TikTok trust security certificates you install yourself, so a tool like mitmproxy can show what the app sends. The risk: anyone who gets a certificate onto your phone can read TikTok's traffic too. Use it only on a test phone.

patches_modified.name: Turn off haptics
patches_modified.description: Stops the little vibrations TikTok makes when you tap or hold things. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Turn off screen transitions
patches_modified.description: Opens and closes TikTok's screens without the sliding animation, so moving around feels quicker. Swipes still follow your finger. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Use non-personalized search
patches_modified.description: Shows search results that aren't tailored to your account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Use system font
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's text in your phone's own font or in a .ttf or .otf font file you import, instead of TikTok's, and can use your phone's emoji too. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches_added.name: Load all saved stickers
patches_added.description: Loads every sticker you saved when you open the sticker panel. PineDrama otherwise shows only the first 100 and never loads the rest. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_added.name: Report a newer phone to effects
patches_added.description: Tells TikTok's effects server you have a newer phone, so effects it turns down on older phones get another chance. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Allow Duet and Stitch
patches_modified.description: Shows the Duet and Stitch buttons on videos whose creator turned them off, so you can still make one, and Add to Story in the share sheet and on stories when the creator turned off content reuse. TikTok may still refuse some videos or the upload. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows the Duet and Stitch buttons on videos whose creator turned them off, so you can still make one. TikTok may still refuse some videos or the upload. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.

patches_modified.name: Hide profile shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Hides the shortcuts you pick from the row under a profile's bio, like TikTok Studio or Your orders, and can hide the Thoughts bubble, and Balance and the TikTok Minis icons in your profile's menu. It can also turn Thoughts on for accounts TikTok left out. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the shortcuts you pick from the row under a profile's bio, like TikTok Studio or Your orders, and can hide the Thoughts bubble, and Balance and the TikTok Minis icons in your profile's menu. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Remove avatar rings
patches_modified.description: Takes the story and LIVE rings off profile pictures, so tapping a picture opens the profile instead of a story or LIVE. It can also open a LIVE creator's Story from their profile picture or their chat in the Inbox. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes the story and LIVE rings off profile pictures, so tapping a picture opens the profile instead of a story or LIVE. It can also open a LIVE creator's Story from their profile picture. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_added.name: Allow photo comments
patches_added.description: Lets PineDrama's comment box ask TikTok's server about photo comments, like TikTok does. TikTok's server still decides whether your account can post one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_removed.name: Always upload in HD
